hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Europe, occupying five-sixths of the island of Ireland in the North Atlantic Ocean, west of Great Britain || mostly flat to rolling interior plain surrounded by rugged hills and low mountains; sea cliffs on west coast || strategic location on major air and sea routes between North America and northern Europe; over 40% of the population resides within 100 km of Dublin || Resources: natural gas, peat, copper, lead, zinc, silver, barite, gypsum, limestone, dolomite || Exports: vaccines, packaged medicine, nitrogen compounds, integrated circuits, hormones (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat to rolling interior plain surrounded by rugged hills and low mountains; sea cliffs on west coast || Western Europe, occupying five-sixths of the island of Ireland in the North Atlantic Ocean, west of Great Britain

climate.excerpt: temperate maritime; modified by North Atlantic Current; mild winters, cool summers; consistently humid; overcast about half the time || rare extreme weather events

economy.excerpt: high-income, export-oriented EU economy; large multinational business sector contributes to growth and tax revenues but poses volatility risks; high living standards; strong labor market challenged by skill shortages and aging workforce || Exports: vaccines, packaged medicine, nitrogen compounds, integrated circuits, hormones (2023) || Industries: pharmaceuticals, chemicals, computer hardware and software, food products, beverages and brewing; medical devices

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: English (official, the language generally used), Irish (Gaelic or Gaeilge) (official, spoken by approximately 37.7% of the population) || Roman Catholic 69.2% (includes lapsed), Protestant 3.7% (Church of Ireland/England/Anglican/Episcopalian 2.5%, other Protestant 1.2%), Orthodox 2%, other Christian 0.9%, Muslim 1.6%, other 1.4%, agnostic/atheist 0.1%, none 14.5%, unspecified 6.7% (2022 est.) || Irish 76.6%, Irish travelers 0.6%, other White 9.9%, Asian 3.3%, Black 1.5%, other (includes Arab, Roma, and persons of mixed backgrounds) 2%, unspecified 2.6% (2022 est.)
